title: Genus-3 certified public pipeline
objective: Implement the ordinary-Python rforest residue to uniquely certified genus-3 local-factor pipeline with deterministic Jacobian/twist filtering and exact fallbacks

handoff.summary: Implemented the ordinary-Python exact genus-3 rforest completion orchestrator. It exhaustively lifts modular rows, normalizes odd generalized models to Y^2=h^2+4f, partitions primary/twist candidate orders into fixed-(c1,c2) maximal stride-p progressions, consumes only independently rechecked exact element-order certificates, and uses exact per-row fallbacks for every unsupported, unresolved, or resource-limited case. Focused end-to-end tests exercise real rforest ingress, dynamic primary/twist witnesses, generalized and even-degree models, malformed native evidence, resource caps, and a one-traversal interval.
risks: The public frobenius dispatcher and strict-module registry are centrally owned and intentionally remain integration changes.
The ordinary group path uses bounded trial-division factorization and is a correctness fallback, not the production performance path.
docs:check reported the expected stale generated reference after adding a new module; integration must regenerate centrally owned reference artifacts.
The lane-native gate was interrupted during its rebuild at coordinator request; the integrated native kernel branch owns the current full native receipt.
next_steps: Cherry-pick fbe998ad and add certified_genus3.py to pyrightconfig.json.
Wire explicit rational algorithm='rforest' to rforest_genus3_local_factor and interval dispatch to rforest_genus3_local_factors; leave auto unchanged until the performance gate passes.
Bind _native_order_certificates to the integrated progression-search kernel and convert its packed Mumford result to the documented Python certificate record.
Regenerate reference documentation and run the final integrated native/platform suites.
